page.layout: Left printed page: fragments of its right-hand lines at the left edge of the scan. Right printed page: running head "PARS II." with page number at top right; then one text block of paragraphs, with number diagrams in between; the diagram continues below the cut.; One printed page, main text in one column with a diagram of fraction lines above it; a fragment of the facing page's margin notes at the far left edge.

p.i: In sequenti exemplo quatuor rationes continuantur, atque ita quotlibet in minimis terminis connecti possunt.

main_text.p: Proportionis igitur quæstiones, in quibus numerus quispiam partiendus occurrit, secundùm plures rationes diuersis terminis ita cohærentes, ut eorū alter præcedentem, alter cósequentem L 2 ratio-

page.notes: Left-page fragments are cut at the scan edge and printed in a different column; the fraction arrangements are set as printed and are approximate in their spacing. The diagram lines are fraction and ratio figures; the numerals are copied as printed with fractions shown as n/d. The left-edge fragments belong to the facing page's marginal notes ("uandæ", "si quòd", "fitis") and are not transcribed. The top of the diagram is cut off on this scan.
